digest.component_or_area: code-review system / Gerrit review bot / project criterion deployment
propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load the review-phase-boundaries criterion from the rebar repository and execute it through the four-pass pipeline in a live probe, not an offline replay, to validate end-to-end project-criterion execution.

A four-patchset Gerrit dogfood sequence must record that the positive-control discovery refinement produces no project-criterion finding, the historical severity-only directive abstains due to missing phase information, the predeclared RP-F2 FIRE control produces an advisory finding with reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria project.review-phase-boundaries, and the final patchset removes invalid directives and contains only phase-compliant instructions.

The dogfood probe must preserve blocking_enabled=false and block_threshold=0.90 throughout, leave the repository with only valid review instructions, and defer any blocking promotion decision to a separate, data-backed ticket.

The operator must record Gerrit change id, patchset SHA, UTC timestamp, bot vote/message, and code_review_result_v2 artifact evidence for each patchset, including Pass-2 validity/impact/verification and Pass-3 priority/decision/threshold/posture attributes.

If the deployed project criterion does not produce the expected project-attributed finding on the RP-F2 FIRE control patchset, a bug must be recorded and the dogfood story marked blocked pending repair before rerun.

The final cleaned patchset must be the sole probe revision submitted to main, verified with git log grep, and the dogfood must conclude with a calibration handoff noting Priority distribution and deferring Blocking promotion to a future separately-reviewed ticket.
